journey.name: Post Creation, Polls, Hashtags, and Audio Clips
journey.description: Tests switching to Feed (1:1) mode, inspecting Adjust/Filter controls, 5s Audio clip controls, attaching a Poll with options, and hashtag caption support.

actions.action: Verify that 'Adjust' and 'Audio 5s' tools are displayed
Tap the 'Audio 5s' tool and verify the '5-Second Post Audio Clip', 'Record 5s', and 'Import' controls are visible
Tap the 'Adjust' tool and verify photo filter presets and Rotate/Flip/Reset buttons are visible
Scroll down and tap 'Add Poll to Post (optional)'
Enter 'Best hangout spot?' into 'Ask a question...', 'North Pier' into 'Option 1', and 'Boardwalk' into 'Option 2'
Enter 'Sunset check #pier #sunset' into the post caption field
Verify that 'Share Post' button is visible (disabled without a photo, enabled once a photo is selected)
Tap the 'Feed' bottom navigation tab to return to Feed
